tools.name: search
tools.description: Search research software, publications, clinical studies, datasets and regional data resources in the Delaware Valley. Research listings carry Verified or Listed evidence labels; regional data resources describe their geographic coverage and access. Use the Valley Desk URL to cite a listing.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get one directory record by id or Valley Desk URL. Research listings include regional evidence; regional data resources include geographic coverage, source and access guidance.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List directory records added on or after a date. Research listings include evidence labels; regional data resources describe geographic coverage. The added date can differ from the research or data release date.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List the regional institutions in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the institution filter in search.

tools.name: list_topics_and_counties
tools.description: List the topics and the nine Delaware Valley counties in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the topic or county filter in search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search The Valley Desk directory of research software, publications and clinical studies connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley (Philadelphia region). Matches titles, topics, institutions and keywords. Every filter is optional. Returns up to 24 records per page with the site URL, the Verified " → after: "Search research software, publications, clinical studies, datasets and regional data resources in the Delaware Valley. Research listings carry Verified or Listed evidence labels; regional data resources describe their geographic coverage and access. Use the Valley Desk URL to cite a listing."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
